one_line: Physician and reformer who founded the Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science in colonial Calcutta.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, medium height, lean but sturdy build with an intense, energetic posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with a slightly high forehead, light brown Bengali complexion, sharp nose, well-groomed black moustache, thin sideburns, thoughtful eyes with small round spectacles, default expression a calm, determined focus as if explaining an idea.
appearance.hair: Short, neatly combed black hair parted slightly to the left, with a few flyaway strands at the front; no turban or cap, bare-headed for an intellectual, urban look of 1870s Calcutta.
appearance.costume: A mid-19th-century Bengali bhadralok outfit: long off-white cotton panjabi (knee-length kurta) with narrow stand collar and simple front buttons, worn over ankle-length white dhoti with clean pleats and border, a dark indigo woolen shawl draped over the shoulders (one end hanging to mid-thigh), and simple brown leather shoes; fabrics look plain but well-kept, indicating an educated professional rather than aristocratic luxury.
appearance.signature: A rolled parchment-style document tied with a red ribbon held confidently in one hand, representing the founding deed of the Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science, with a small brass pocket watch on a chain subtly visible at his waist to hint at his disciplined, modern outlook.

ref_desc: Mahendralal Sarkar is a late-30s Bengali man with an oval light-brown face, short parted black hair, moustache, round spectacles, wearing an off-white panjabi over a white dhoti with dark indigo shawl and brown shoes, holding a rolled red-tied deed document.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Mahendralal Sarkar: a late-30s Bengali man with an oval light-brown face, sharp nose, neat black moustache, thin sideburns and small round spectacles, his short black hair parted slightly left with a few loose strands. He wears an off-white knee-length cotton panjabi with a narrow stand collar and simple buttons, over a clean white dhoti wrapped to the ankles with visible pleats and border, and simple brown leather shoes. A dark indigo woolen shawl is draped over his shoulders, one end hanging forward to mid-thigh, the other resting along his back. In his right hand he confidently holds a rolled parchment-style document tied with a red ribbon, subtly suggesting the founding deed of the Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science, while a small brass pocket watch on a chain peeks from his waist. Use a palette dominated by off-white, white, dark indigo, brown and a touch of red, and show him from front, three-quarter and back views to clearly display his face, hair, garments and the deed scroll prop.
